definitions.explanation: A sphere in the geometric sense — a perfectly round three-dimensional shape. Used in math, science, and the names of round objects. Distinct from ボール, which refers to balls used in sports.

examples.japanese: {球|きゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体積|たいせき}→体積：04492_taiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: Calculate the volume of a sphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧な{球|きゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The Earth is not a perfect sphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{球|きゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面積|ひょうめんせき}→表面積：28898_hyoumenseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四倍|よんばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the radius doubles, the surface area of a sphere becomes four times larger.

notes:
Single-character noun used in geometry and as the building block of many compounds. In ordinary speech a round object is more often ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧ (sports ball) or ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ (small round thing).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧: Earth ("earth-sphere")
- ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧: baseball
- ⟦{電球|でんきゅう}→電球：03125_denkyuu⟧: light bulb
- {半球|はんきゅう}: hemisphere
- ⟦{球体|きゅうたい}→球体：20366_kyuutai⟧: a sphere (the abstract shape)
- {球面|きゅうめん}: spherical surface

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧: ball (sports, toys) — everyday word for a ball you can throw or kick
- ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧: bead; small ball; bullet — everyday small round things
